title: A new nation
note: Drafted for Prompt 12 (Unit 4). Every lesson is a draft until a person reviews it (content/course/README.md).

listen.explanationKey: What founding document was written in 1787?
facts: The U.S. Constitution was written in 1787.
James Madison is called the Father of the Constitution.
He was also the fourth President, and President during the War of 1812.

newWords.meaning: an important paper written when the country began
the 1787 meeting in Philadelphia where the Constitution was written

story.say: The U.S. Constitution was written in 1787.

help.simpler: The Constitution was written in the year 1787.
help.example: The Declaration came first, in 1776. The Constitution came 11 years later.
help.why: The test asks what founding document was written in 1787.

story.say: It was written at a meeting called the Constitutional Convention.

help.simpler: Leaders from the states met to write the Constitution.
help.example: A convention is a big meeting with a purpose.
help.why: This is where the founding document was written.

check.prompt: What founding document was written in 1787?

story.say: James Madison is called the Father of the Constitution.

help.simpler: Madison did a lot of the work to plan and write the Constitution.
help.example: People call him its “father” because he helped create it.
help.why: “Father of the Constitution” is an answer on the test.

story.say: Later, he was the fourth President of the United States.

help.simpler: Three Presidents came before Madison. He was number four.
help.example: Jefferson was the third President. Madison came next.
help.why: “Fourth President” is another answer about Madison.

check.statement: James Madison was the fourth President.

story.say: He was President during the War of 1812.

help.simpler: A war started in 1812, while Madison was President.
help.example: The War of 1812 was fought against Britain.
help.why: “President during the War of 1812” is an answer on the test.

check.prompt: James Madison is famous for many things. Name one.

listen.explanationKey: The Federalist Papers supported the passage of the U.S. Constitution. Name one of the writers.
facts: The Federalist Papers were essays written to support passing the Constitution.
They helped people understand the Constitution.
James Madison, Alexander Hamilton and John Jay wrote them, under the name Publius.

newWords.meaning: a short piece of writing about one idea
to be for something and help it

story.say: After the Constitution was written, the states had to agree to it.

help.simpler: The new Constitution needed a yes from the states.
help.example: To ratify means to approve it officially.
help.why: This is why the Federalist Papers were written.

story.say: The Federalist Papers were essays written to support passing the Constitution.

help.simpler: Writers asked people to say yes to the Constitution.
help.example: An essay is a short piece of writing that explains an idea.
help.why: “They supported passing the Constitution” is an answer on the test.

story.say: They helped people understand the Constitution.

help.simpler: The essays explained what the Constitution meant.
help.example: They were printed in newspapers for people to read.
help.why: “They helped people understand the Constitution” is an answer too.

check.prompt: Why were the Federalist Papers important?
choices: They helped people understand the Constitution.

story.say: James Madison, Alexander Hamilton and John Jay wrote them.

help.simpler: Three men wrote the Federalist Papers together.
help.example: Madison, Hamilton and Jay: three writers.
help.why: The test asks you to name one of the writers.

story.say: They signed the essays with one name: Publius.

help.simpler: All three used the same name instead of their own names.
help.example: Publius is also a right answer for “one of the writers.”
help.why: Any one of the four names is right on the test.

check.prompt: Name one of the writers of the Federalist Papers.

listen.explanationKey: George Washington is famous for many things. Name one.
facts: George Washington is called the Father of Our Country. He was the first President and led the Continental Army.
Benjamin Franklin helped write the Declaration of Independence. He was an inventor and a U.S. diplomat.
Franklin also started the first free public libraries and was the first Postmaster General.

newWords.meaning: a person who makes something new
a person who works with other countries for their country

story.say: George Washington is called the Father of Our Country.

help.simpler: Washington was so important that people call him the country’s father.
help.example: He helped start the United States.
help.why: “Father of Our Country” is an answer on the test.

story.say: He led the Continental Army in the Revolutionary War.

help.simpler: Washington was the general of the American army.
help.example: He led the army from the start of the war to the end.
help.why: “General of the Continental Army” is an answer on the test.

story.say: Later, he was the first President of the United States.

help.simpler: Washington was the very first President.
help.example: Every President since has followed him.
help.why: “First President” is an answer on the test.

check.prompt: George Washington is famous for many things. Name one.

story.say: Benjamin Franklin helped write the Declaration of Independence.

help.simpler: Franklin worked with Jefferson on the Declaration.
help.example: Jefferson wrote it. Franklin was one of the helpers.
help.why: “Helped write the Declaration” is an answer about Franklin.

story.say: He was an inventor, and a U.S. diplomat.

help.simpler: He made new things, and he worked with other countries for the U.S.
help.example: An inventor makes new things. A diplomat speaks for a country abroad.
help.why: “Inventor” and “U.S. diplomat” are answers on the test.

check.statement: Benjamin Franklin was the first President.

story.say: He started the first free public libraries and was the first Postmaster General.

help.simpler: He helped people borrow books for free, and he ran the mail.
help.example: The Postmaster General leads the country’s mail service.
help.why: Both are answers on the test.

check.prompt: Benjamin Franklin is famous for many things. Name one.

readIt.sentence: Who is the Father of Our Country?

writeIt.sentence: Washington is the Father of Our Country.

listen.explanationKey: Alexander Hamilton is famous for many things. Name one.
facts: Alexander Hamilton was the first Secretary of the Treasury.
He helped start the First Bank of the United States and was one of the writers of the Federalist Papers.
He was an aide to General George Washington. Washington is on the one-dollar bill, and Hamilton is on the ten-dollar bill.

newWords.meaning: the part of government that takes care of money
a person who helps a leader

story.say: Alexander Hamilton was the first Secretary of the Treasury.

help.simpler: Hamilton was the first leader of the country’s money office.
help.example: The Treasury takes care of the government’s money.
help.why: “First Secretary of the Treasury” is an answer on the test.

story.say: He helped start the First Bank of the United States.

help.simpler: Hamilton helped create the country’s first national bank.
help.example: A bank keeps money safe and lends it.
help.why: “Helped establish the First Bank” is an answer on the test.

story.say: He was one of the writers of the Federalist Papers.

help.simpler: Hamilton wrote many of these essays, with Madison and Jay.
help.example: The essays explained the Constitution.
help.why: “One of the writers of the Federalist Papers” is an answer.

check.prompt: Alexander Hamilton is famous for many things. Name one.

story.say: During the Revolutionary War, he was an aide to General George Washington.

help.simpler: Hamilton worked closely with Washington during the war.
help.example: An aide is a helper who works for a leader.
help.why: “Aide to General George Washington” is an answer on the test.

check.statement: Hamilton helped George Washington during the war.

story.say: George Washington is on the one-dollar bill.

help.simpler: Look at a one-dollar bill: that is Washington.
help.example: The one-dollar bill is the bill people use most.
help.why: This helps you remember who Washington is.

story.say: Alexander Hamilton is on the ten-dollar bill.

help.simpler: Look at a ten-dollar bill: that is Hamilton.
help.example: Hamilton is on the money he helped organize.
help.why: This helps you remember who Hamilton is.

check.prompt: Tap the bill with Alexander Hamilton.

readIt.sentence: Who is on the dollar bill?

writeIt.sentence: Washington is on the dollar bill.
